editorial:
Imagine you are heading to a cozy vacation home for a family getaway, only to discover that a group of tiny aliens has taken over the attic. That is exactly the fun setup you get here, and it is a blast from start to finish. The story follows a bunch of kids who stumble upon these little invaders and quickly realize the adults are completely clueless. So it is up to the kids to save the day using their wits, gadgets, and teamwork. The vibe is light, silly, and packed with slapstick humor that keeps things moving at a brisk pace. You will find yourself laughing at the aliens' goofy antics and cheering for the kids as they outsmart the grown-ups.

The acting from the young cast is surprisingly solid, and the alien designs are cute enough to keep younger viewers entertained without being scary. The action scenes are energetic, though some of the effects show their age. On the downside, the plot is pretty predictable, and a few jokes fall flat. Still, if you want a fun family night movie that does not take itself too seriously, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the kids manage to defeat the alien leader and send the remaining aliens back into space using a homemade device. The adults finally learn the truth but are amazed rather than scared. The twist reveals that one friendly alien named Sparks decides to stay behind with the family, becoming a secret pet. The movie ends with the kids enjoying their vacation, now with a tiny alien friend hidden in their home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventures with silly aliens and brave kids.
